Budget.description: The caps of an experiment: those of one run, and those of the job that runs its cells, with the number of runs that may be in flight at once.

max_cost_usd.$comment: Above 0 and finite; the reader enforces it.
max_cost_usd.description: The cap on the cost of the job in US dollars, above 0.

max_parallel.$comment: Fits in 32 bits; the reader enforces it.
max_parallel.description: The number of agent runs or evaluator processes in flight at once, from 1; 1 when absent.

max_runs.$comment: Fits in 32 bits; the reader enforces it.
max_runs.description: The cap on the runs the job starts, from 1.

max_tokens.$comment: Fits in 64 bits; a reader that holds numbers as doubles is exact only below 2^53.
max_tokens.description: The cap on the tokens the job spends, from 1.

per_run.description: The caps on one agent run.

wall_s.$comment: Fits in 32 bits; the reader enforces it.
wall_s.description: The wall-clock cap of the job in seconds, from 1.

ExperimentInput.description: An input a run reads: a file or a directory, found relative to the experiment file, and who sees it.

at.$comment: A relative path with no `..` segment; the Rust reader refuses an absolute path and a `..` segment.
at.description: The workspace directory the input is mounted under; `.` when absent.

audience.description: Who sees the input; the agent when absent.

kind.description: What the input is, as a plain name; unique among the inputs of a file.

path.description: The file or directory, relative to the experiment file.

Factor.description: A field that varies across the cells of an experiment: its path and its levels, in the order they are written.

levels.description: The values the field takes, one cell per value; at least one.

items.$comment: A leaf of an object level is any value that is not an object; the keys are field path segments, an object holds at least one leaf, and a leaf is not null. Integers lie within ±(2^53 - 1). JSON Schema cannot state this, and the Rust reader enforces it.
items.description: One value of a factor: any JSON value except null, or an object whose leaves fill the paths under the factor's path.

path.description: The dotted path of the field.

FieldPath.description: A dotted path to a field: one or more segments joined by `.`, each a lowercase letter followed by lowercase letters, digits or `_`.

GitCommit.description: A git commit: 40 or 64 lowercase hex digits.

HarnessRequest.description: The harness an experiment asks for: its name and, when it limits them, the versions that will do.

version.$comment: The grammar is that of the Rust `semver` crate's `VersionReq`; the reader parses it.
version.description: The versions of the harness that will do, as comparators such as `>=2.1, <3`; any version when absent.

InputAudience.description: Who sees an input: the agent, in its workspace, or only the evaluators.

oneOf.description: The agent sees the input, mounted read-only in its workspace.
Only the evaluators see the input; it never enters the agent's workspace.

Name.description: A plain name, such as that of a harness, a reader, a plug-in or a treatment: non-empty, with neither `@` nor white space.

PerRunCaps.description: The caps on one agent run: a treatment condition, the same for every arm.

max_cost_usd.$comment: Above 0 and finite; the reader enforces it.
max_cost_usd.description: The cap on the cost of one run in US dollars, above 0.

turns.$comment: Fits in 32 bits; the reader enforces it.
turns.description: The cap on the turns of one run, from 1.

wall_s.$comment: Fits in 32 bits; the reader enforces it.
wall_s.description: The wall-clock cap of one run in seconds, from 1.

SecretName.description: An environment-variable name: an uppercase ASCII letter or `_`, then uppercase letters, digits or `_`.

TreatmentSpec.description: The treatment an experiment file declares: a name, the tag and commit it is pinned to, and where its files are.

commit.description: The commit the treatment is pinned to.

source.description: Where the treatment's files are, as a path relative to the experiment file.

tag.description: The tag the treatment is pinned to, as its source names it.

description: An experiment file: the values fixed in every cell, the factors whose levels make the cells, the replicates, the budget, the harness, the treatment and the names of the secrets the runs need.

budget.description: The caps on a run and on the job.

factors.$comment: No path of a factor, nor a path a level fills, equals or lies below or above another factor's path or a key of `fixed`; the Rust reader refuses an overlap.
factors.description: The factors, in the order the cells are made from them: the first factor varies slowest.

fixed.description: The values every cell holds, by dotted field path.

^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(?:[.][a-z][a-z0-9_]*)*(.$comment: Integers lie within ±(2^53 - 1); JSON Schema cannot state this, and the Rust reader refuses a larger one.
^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(?:[.][a-z][a-z0-9_]*)*(.description: Any JSON value except null at the top, with finite numbers.

inputs.$comment: The kinds are unique and none is `build_inputs`; the Rust reader refuses a repeated or reserved kind.
inputs.description: The files and directories the runs read, with who sees each.

replicates.$comment: Fits in 32 bits; the reader enforces it.
replicates.description: The runs of each cell, from 1.

schema.description: The version marker of the document: always `experiment/1`.

secrets.description: The names of the environment variables the runs need; their values are never written.

treatment.description: The treatment the runs apply, and where its files are.

title: ExperimentFile
